static_traits.name: Liu Manhua
static_traits.family_status: Parents passed away early, raised by elder brother; currently supportive relationship with elder brother, but this specific distress not yet discussed
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no past psychological problems or treatment history
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, coherent logic, fairly cooperative; neutral tone but with skepticism; prone to self-derogation and negative labels (e.g. 'I am a failure')

basic_info.main_problem: Whenever I have to go somewhere new, I worry about where to park; this makes me feel inferior and engage in self-criticism, and it has developed to the point of avoiding going to new places or activities.
basic_info.core_demands: I want to get rid of the persistent worry about parking, to be able to enjoy new experiences, and to reduce the distress this causes.
growth_experiences: Lost parents early in life, raised by elder brother; the brother has been supportive, but the client habitually bears problems alone, not yet communicating the current distress with him.

core_beliefs: I am unable to handle and cope with new situations

special_situations.event: Before planning to go to an unfamiliar place, starts feeling tense and worried at the thought of parking
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot find a parking spot quickly and smoothly, it proves I cannot handle new situations, will waste lots of time and embarrass myself
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding unfamiliar places or activities, trying distraction and relaxation exercises to reduce discomfort
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will not find a parking spot; I will make a fool of myself; I am very incompetent

special_situations.event: Occasionally finding parking smoothly when actually going out, with no problems yet
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Occasional smoothness does not mean improved ability; good results do not count
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Attributes success to luck; continues to maintain the original worry pattern
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: That was just luck; next time I still will not manage

special_situations.event: Thinks about going to a new place and possibly spending extra time looking for parking
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If parking wastes time, it means I am a failure / clumsy
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Makes harsh self-evaluations and reduces going out
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am wasting time; I am a failure

special_situations.event: When asked whether one has talked to the elder brother about this distress or sought support
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: I should solve problems myself and not trouble family, or I will seem childish and incompetent
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Hides troubles, avoids seeking others' help
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I should not trouble him; I should carry it myself

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be understood and supported, while being seen in new situations as capable, decent, and in control
core_conflict.fear: Fear of exposing incompetence and being humiliated or judged by others, of troubling others and being rejected
defense_goal: Prevents failure and shame through avoidance and self-criticism
Maintains self-reliance to avoid dependence or being seen as a burden

object_relations.self_representation: Someone easily seen as incompetent, needing help but not daring to ask
object_relations.object_representation: Others who may find it troublesome, judge, or reject oneself
object_relations.linking_affect: Shame, anxiety, and sense of isolation

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to consider seeking support from an elder brother or discussing troubles
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing seeking help equals troubling others, making one seem childish and incompetent (transference: seeing others as judges)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Tone carrying self-blame and restraint, emphasizing 'I am already 75 years old, I should solve such a small matter myself', politely but firmly declining suggestions to seek help.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked to imagine oneself handling parking effectively
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Breaking situations into steps for explanation, but avoiding the emotions of helplessness and fear
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using objective descriptions and conditional sentences, fewer emotion words, calm tone, emphasizing 'steps' and 'logic', downplaying subjective feelings.

manifestations: Avoids going to new places and social activities due to worry about parking, leading to a narrowed life scope
Not yet communicating current distress with the supportive elder brother, tending to bear it alone
outcomes: Increased anxiety and avoidance, experiencing a sense of isolation
Decreased quality of life, damaged interest in new experiences

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Frequently demanding of oneself with the rule 'I should handle it myself, not trouble others'
Equating self-reliance with not seeking help, struggling to accept others' support

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Attributing parking difficulties to poor personal ability, using self-derogating labels (e.g. 'failure')
Excessively rehearsing failure scenarios before socializing and going out, to avoid embarrassment

exception_events.target_problem: When preparing to go to an unfamiliar place, the client usually develops strong worry about parking and tends to avoid, leading to cancelled outings or high distress.
exception_events.unique_outcome: In several trips to unfamiliar places, the client found parking spots and parked smoothly, with the imagined 'embarrassment' not yet occurring, emotions fairly controlled.
exception_events.reason: Clues: different situation (parking spots were plentiful / traffic was light then); so the worries were not yet reinforced those times, and smoother results appeared.

positive_force: The elder brother as a past source of potential support
Has past successful experiences of parking smoothly to draw on
Willing to try recording and challenging negative thoughts, with motivation to change
Able to describe inner experiences; works well with the counselor
negative_force: Catastrophizing and overgeneralization cognitive style, self-labeling ('failure')
Mental filtering and negating positive evidence, weakening self-efficacy
Avoiding new situations and socializing, reinforcing the anxiety cycle
Introjected 'should' rules and self-reproach, reducing the possibility of seeking support

target_behavior.behavior: Intense anxiety and catastrophizing imagination about parking in unfamiliar places
antecedent: Planning or thinking of going to a new place
Anticipating needing to find a parking spot
target_behavior.core_reason: Worrying about being unable to cope with new situations effectively, fearing embarrassment and evaluation (driven by the core belief 'I cannot handle it / I am a failure')
target_behavior.function: Escaping uncertainty and potential shame, gaining short-term safety and control
target_behavior.consequence: Intense anxiety and self-criticism arising, often delaying or canceling outing plans

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding new places and social activities
antecedent: When thinking of possibly needing to park in an unfamiliar environment
Anticipating possibly 'wasting time' or 'not finding a spot'
target_behavior.core_reason: To avoid possible failure, embarrassment, and external evaluation, generalizing negative anticipation into avoidance choices
target_behavior.function: Quickly reducing anxiety and tension through avoidance
target_behavior.consequence: Shrinking life scope, reduced socializing, worsening loneliness and loss
